dict.string: The Copilot uses the camera to photograph a shelf for on-device planogram compliance checks. Photos are analysed on this device.
The Store Associate Copilot uses the microphone so you can speak a product query instead of typing it. Speech is transcribed on this device and is not sent anywhere.
Speech recognition runs entirely on this device to turn your spoken product query into text for on-device semantic search. No audio or transcript leaves the device.
